releases.summary: The page direction now follows the interface language (English is left to right; Hebrew and Yiddish stay right to left). Background images are cached. Council: first relayed review recorded.
Landing page names the universal tools and has one entry action per state. Guest-to-account sign-in keeps the account's data and saves the guest's discarded settings with a Restore option.

Neutral default classroom for new visitors (Whiteboard, Timer, Name picker, Traffic light, Sound level, Text, More, Settings). Date under the clock is the local date by default, with a setting. Guests no longer get a blocking sign-in popup. Empty states for the name picker and schedule.
ClassroomBoard name everywhere (titles, manifest). Privacy, Terms and Help pages. Share-preview metadata. Current settings screenshot on the landing page.
Hebrew and Yiddish text for the new Account, Share and Undo strings. Public GitHub snapshot.
Simplified Account and Share pages. Ordinary removals use an Undo bar instead of confirm dialogs.
Native Saved links page. Shared Apple-style sheet for widget settings.
Native Behavior and stars page. New centered confirm and ask dialogs.
Yiddish text revised. Classroom wording presets.
Theme, accent color, interface size, toolbar position, labels and interface language.
